name: The Trap Shack
notes: 5 photos: 1 and 2 are printed menu boards with prices, merged and cross-checked against each other; 3 and 4 are photo-collage boards naming dishes with no prices, used only to confirm names; 5 is a bottled-drinks display, skipped. CBAD Lobster Tacos price conflicts between board 1 ($24, Tacos/Fries/More section) and board 2 ($15, Trap Signatures section); kept $24 as the dedicated tacos-section price. Alcoholic/non-alcoholic drink lists and the plain Sno-Balls flavor list skipped as drink/dessert-base items with no single price.
